semantic_findings.finding: P460 records that one Wikidata item is said to be the same as another; its own description says the assertion may be uncertain or disputed.

P518 is restrictive. On this statement it limits the P460 assertion to the named part, aspect, or form Q9085982, labelled type IIA string theory. This review does not replace the official qualifier wording with a stronger physics interpretation.

P460 being symmetric does not make the observed edge a formal mathematical equivalence relation. Formal equivalence also requires reflexivity and transitivity, and these sources supply neither those properties for this item set nor a proof of physical equivalence.

The statement has normal rank and no references. Wikidata documents normal rank as neutral and as making no accuracy or currency judgement, so rank must not be displayed as verification or confidence.

atlas_handling_recommendation.decision: Retain this as a qualified, source-attributed assertion edge. Do not merge nodes, render equality, compute transitive closure, or present it as a proved mathematical or physical equivalence.
